notes.photo: Both remove noise but erase fine parachute cords. JDD256 building is blurred; JDD retains more grain/fine structure but is still softer than GT. No full-photo ranking from two selected fields.
notes.gfx: Both skies smooth. Building truss softens in both. JDD retains more foliage structure and more coherent fence mesh than JDD256, with more residual grain. Independent ISO100 reference is not GT; CPU port is not yet validated against original CUDA execution.

result.scope: Selected native100% panels only; no broad superiority, fullframe output/speed or model promotion.

manual_review.direct_row_finding: V43 fence mesh is more continuous/regular than RawForge JDD; RawForge retains more residual grain and has weaker/less regular crossings. Fine foliage stays soft in both.

definition.scope: Wait for actual successful exit of final palette review1753053. limits: Only2 fixed synthetic photos/4 saved GFX512 contexts, no new RAW decoding or protected-final scoring.
